# New Jersey Policy Perspective

> A nonpartisan think tank advancing economic, social, and racial justice through policy research, budget analysis, and advocacy in New Jersey.

NJPP conducts rigorous policy research and fiscal analysis on critical issues including tax policy, economic justice, health coverage, and immigrants' rights. The organization combines research expertise with community engagement and leadership development programs.

## Key Topics

- Economic Justice
- Tax Policy
- Budget Analysis
- Health Coverage
- Immigrants' Rights
- Policy Research
- Fiscal Justice
- New Jersey
- Child Poverty
- Income Inequality
- Medicaid
- Corporate Taxation
- Think Tank
- Nonprofit Advocacy
- Policy Reform

## Policy Issues

- [Tax and Budget](https://www.njpp.org/issues/tax-budget): Tax and budget analysis: fiscal-year 2027, corporate taxation, wealth tax
- [Economic Justice](https://www.njpp.org/issues/economic-justice): Economic justice policy: child poverty, income inequality, family tax credits
- [Health](https://www.njpp.org/issues/health): Health policy: Medicaid, health coverage access, mental health
- [Immigrants' Rights](https://www.njpp.org/issues/immigrants-rights): Immigrants' rights policy: immigration reform, protection, health coverage

## About NJPP

- [New Jersey Policy Perspective](https://www.njpp.org): NJPP homepage: nonpartisan think tank advancing economic, social, and racial justice
- [Our Work and Impact](https://www.njpp.org/about/our-work-impact): Detailed description of NJPP's policy research and advocacy work
- [Board](https://www.njpp.org/about/board): NJPP board members and organizational leadership team
- [Crotty Fellowship](https://www.njpp.org/about/crotty-fellowship): Kathleen Crotty Fellowship: paid summer policy analysis and advocacy program
- [Career Opportunities](https://www.njpp.org/about/career-opportunities): NJPP job postings and career opportunities in policy analysis
